verdict.rationale: Angular exposes a well-documented CLI (ng new, build, test, lint, update, config, etc.) that functions as a scriptable public interface, and it publishes an llms.txt for AI discoverability plus 'AI-forward resources' pages, suggesting some agent-friendly tooling. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated programmatic/automation API (e.g., SDK, REST/RPC interface) intended for AI agents to drive the framework beyond the CLI. Missing for 10: a documented agent/automation-specific API or SDK beyond the CLI, and independent corroboration that AI agents actually use these interfaces successfully.
